title: Architecture Decision Record (Nygard-style skeleton with frontmatter)

consequences.description: Record positive, negative and neutral consequences in the Nygard format. Validation does not depend on ADR creation dates or edit history.

confirmation.description: spec-detail (2026-07-09): Optional, derived from MADR. Declare a fitness function, search or test that checks adherence to this decision. The source of truth is artifacts/architecture-contract/semantics.md section 18.

decision_bindings.description: Project-root-relative files constrained by this decision at runtime. For an accepted ADR, each file must explicitly name the ADR ID in decision_ref or a comment and be included in source_paths.
